_note: Daily info bite for the audio brief: one short, fun line read right after "Good morning, Waynesville! It's <day>." Picked by scripts/day-bite.mjs in this order: (1) holidays computed by rule (Thanksgiving, Easter, Mother's Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day, clock changes and so on, coded in day-bite.mjs); (2) a fixed-date entry below, by MM-DD; (3) a countdown (Christmas from the day after Thanksgiving, Thanksgiving in the week before); (4) otherwise today's sunrise, sunset and hours of daylight in Waynesville. A countdown is added after (1) or (2) when one is running. Each fixed entry is a sentence written for the ear; keep it under about 120 characters, light and true. Add entries freely; a date can hold a list, and the line is then picked by year so it changes year to year.

fixed.01-01: Happy New Year! Here's to a great year in the village.
fixed.01-04: It's National Trivia Day, so here's one: Waynesville was laid out in 1797, before Ohio was even a state.
fixed.01-19: It's National Popcorn Day. Movie night, anyone?
fixed.01-21: It's Squirrel Appreciation Day, so give a nod to the busiest neighbors on your block.
fixed.01-23: It's National Pie Day. No judgment if that means pie for breakfast.
fixed.02-02: It's Groundhog Day. Whatever the groundhog says, spring officially arrives in about six and a half weeks.
fixed.02-09: It's National Pizza Day, a fine excuse to order from one of our local spots tonight.
fixed.02-14: Happy Valentine's Day! Downtown Waynesville makes for a pretty sweet date night.
fixed.02-29: It's Leap Day, the bonus day that comes around only once every four years.
fixed.03-01: Happy birthday, Ohio! Our state joined the union on this day in 1803, the seventeenth state.
fixed.03-14: It's Pi Day. Celebrate with a slice of pie, three point one four of them if you're ambitious.
fixed.03-17: Happy St. Patrick's Day! Wear a little green today.
fixed.04-01: It's April Fools' Day, so read everything twice today. Except this brief. This brief is real.
fixed.04-22: It's Earth Day, a good day for a walk on the Little Miami Scenic Trail.
fixed.05-04: It's Star Wars Day. May the Fourth be with you.
fixed.06-14: It's Flag Day. Look for the stars and stripes along Main Street.
fixed.06-19: Today is Juneteenth, the federal holiday marking the end of slavery in the United States.
fixed.07-04: Happy Independence Day! Have a safe and happy Fourth.
fixed.08-26: It's National Dog Day. Give your pup an extra treat today.
fixed.09-11: Today is Patriot Day, a day to remember the lives lost on September 11, 2001.
fixed.09-17: It's Constitution Day, marking the signing of the U.S. Constitution in 1787.
fixed.09-19: It's Talk Like a Pirate Day. Ahoy, Waynesville!
fixed.09-29: It's National Coffee Day. Treat yourself to a cup from a local shop.
fixed.10-31: Happy Halloween! Drive slowly tonight and watch for trick-or-treaters.
fixed.11-11: Today is Veterans Day. Thank you to every veteran in our community for your service.
fixed.11-13: It's World Kindness Day. Hold a door, pay a compliment, check on a neighbor.
fixed.12-04: It's National Cookie Day. You know what to do.
fixed.12-07: Today is National Pearl Harbor Remembrance Day, honoring those lost on December 7, 1941.
fixed.12-21: We're right around the shortest days of the year. From here on, the days start getting longer.
fixed.12-24: It's Christmas Eve. Wherever you're celebrating tonight, merry Christmas from all of us.
fixed.12-31: It's New Year's Eve. Have a safe and happy night, and see you next year.
